programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a day of art, money and bad medicine for the Oddbods! When Jeff kicks Pogo out of his art class, Pogo decides to make his own crazy creations, which become incredibly popular, much to Jeff's horror. Then, Zee strikes oil in his backyard and becomes a 'Zeellionaire'! How will his new money affect his friendships? Plus, Zee tricks Newt into thinking he's sick so she'll take care of him, but how long can he keep up the act?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a competitive day with the Oddbods! When Newt is laughed out of the boys' go-karting activities, she resolves to teach them a lesson and prove she's more than a match for them in a race. Then, Jeff isn't the most athletic, and when he gets roped into a sports game against some overly competitive Greybods, he finds he's out of his depth. Plus, Pogo discovers a remote control that can pause and rewind real life!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he investigates some BIIIG vehicles! First, he heads to a construction site to learn all about bulldozers! After learning how bulldozers work and even getting to bulldoze some things himself, Blippi teaches us the fun Bulldozer Dance! Then, Blippi visits a farm where he gets to learn all about another big vehicle, a tractor swather. He finds out how it's used to cut grass in big fields and even gets to ride around and try it out for himself!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi, Meekah and Ms. Rachel for a big day of creative adventures! The fun begins as they explore the sounds of the city, make a song with instruments and hop on a train. Then Blippi visits the winner of his classroom contest for more learning through play, including a fun game of Freeze Dance, drawing and messy sensory fun with shaving cream!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a sweet treat adventure with Meekah! First, she explores different jobs like Firefighter, Grocer and Veterinarian before sliding into a ball pit! Then, she visits Happy Ice in Los Angeles to learn how to make delicious, colorful desserts. The sweet fun continues at the Gingerbread Factory in Leavenworth! Meekah learns to make icing and turns gingerbread shapes into a fun house with cool decorations!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Zak's greatest invention, the Shrinkinator, backfires, shrinking him and his grandpa down to the size of bugs! Their new bug-sized life immediately gets more complicated when their very first attempt to find the machine's missing parts leads them straight into a trap. Captured by the menacing mite Adilla, they must now outsmart their captor just to continue their quest to get back to normal.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The backyard is turned upside down! The Insectibles are baffled when they encounter Hye, a cockroach walking around without a head. As they investigate this spooky mystery, they face an even bigger problem: a gang of crooks disguised as the Insectibles is committing crimes and ruining their reputation. Now, the team must solve the riddle of the headless bug while hunting down their devious doppelgangers to clear their name.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: It's time to meet the new Park Rangers at T-Rex Ranch! First, a new park ranger, Zoey, joins the team and encounters a mysterious time-rewinding gadget on her first dinosaur mission. The gadget creates all sorts of problems as she tries to navigate the chaos it causes. Then, it's time to meet Cam, the newest member of the park ranger team! On his first mission, he joins Zoey on an adventure to track down the elusive Peteinosaurus dinosaur.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for an epic search and rescue adventure with the Park Rangers! First, Park Ranger Zoey accidentally zaps Park Ranger Maddison into the dinosaur wild zone! She will have to use all her park ranger wit to get out safely. Then, Park Ranger Darren goes off to feed the baby Brachiosaurus, but on his mission, he accidentally loses it! Can the park ranger team work together to find the lost baby dino?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a wild day! An incident with Newt and some local birds causes the accidental launch of Bubbles' rocket into space with the birds inside! Then, Fuse feels excluded when all his neighbors become engrossed in a new 'Pokebod' game on their phones and constantly put themselves in danger. Finally, Pogo prides himself on being a master of the prank and sends Bubbles on an elaborate goose-chase into the snowy mountains.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! After being caught in one of Bubbles' experiments, Fuse and Newt accidentally switch bodies! As Bubbles searches for a way to reverse it, an over-excitable Fuse enters the now curmudgeonly Newt into a dance competition. Then, Slick goes on an increasingly desperate quest to find a 'Golden Ticket' for an exclusive disco-party. Plus, Slick is determined to look his best for the group photo.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.desc: All aboard! Join Blippi for an amazing vehicle adventure on land and sea! First, Blippi takes a tour of a steam train! He gets to learn how steam trains used to work and honks the horn! Then, he visits a bus depot to learn more about buses. He learns about the engine, rides the bus around town and sings a song! Finally, Blippi takes to the sea to learn about boats and gets to explore the inside of a luxurious speedboat.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a fun day at the farm! He's meeting all the amazing animals that live there and learning about their sounds and habits. From friendly horses to mooing cows, Blippi gets a first-h and look at farm life. He learns about what the animals eat and the important jobs they have on the farm in this exciting country adventure.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are taking on some new roles! First, Fuse chops down a tree and finds himself the reluctant parent to a hatchling chick. Will the cute baby bird melt his heart? Then, as a stickler for the rules, Jeff is appointed warden for the cul-de-sac, but he soon gets a taste for his newfound power! Plus, a mysterious UFO keeps stealing cows from nearby fields, and Bubbles goes to investigate.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a summer of fun, learning and camping! Newt discovers that Fuse can't ride a bike because of a childhood trauma, so she kindly offers to teach him. Then, on a sweltering day, Fuse and Zee get into a bickering match over who is last in line for the ice cream van. Finally, Fuse goes camping for some alone time, but his trip is ruined by the arrival of Jeff and all his modern camping conveniences!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Watch out, because these cute creatures are causing big chaos! First, Chroma the Magic Pet has a cold, and every time she sneezes, she causes a huge color splat! Mila and Morphle must find her before the whole city is covered in color. Then, the Baby Morphles arrive from another dimension and they are in the mood for a game of chase! From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: It's a big day of trouble, all thanks to Orphle! First, he uses a Multicolour Cloner to make different colored clones of himself, and it's up to Mila and Morphle to track them all down before they cause too much chaos. Then, when the friends are playing in a cardboard castle, Orphle mistakenly thinks they don't want to play with him and attacks it! From stealing a treasure map to teaming up with Winston, Orphle is causing trouble all day!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Joey and Boo are a pair of losers when their search for food goes wrong. They battle a fly for a pear, get stuck in jelly and ride an out-of-control meatball. They also get trapped inside a worm, get stuck in earwax and deal with a leaky tap. No matter what they do, their simple tasks turn into wild, chaotic adventures.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi has so many buddies that he loves! There's Meekah, and TABBS, and DBO and all of the friends he meets on his adventures. Blippi invites his buddies at home to join him in remembering some of his favorite moments spent with friends. Awwww!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.desc: Grandma Gecko is here to help with some epic rescues! The action starts when Weasel's accelerator gets stuck and he can't stop driving! Then, when lots of vehicles get flat tires from nails on the road, Gecko feels the pressure and calls his Grandma to help him speedily change all the tires. From building a wind turbine to saving Blue, Grandma can do it all!

Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.

programme.title: Dukun
programme.desc: Lawyer, Karim, is searching for his missing child, Nadia. His desperation leads him to be entangled with an alleged murderer, Diana Dahlan. In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: Bodyguard
programme.desc: After losing his loved ones, Soohan also loses the will to leave. Aimless and unmotivated, he and his good friends Taeyoung and Jincheol work for a loan shark, although Soohan cannot even muster any enthusiasm for a life in crime. One day, he chances into a heiress Yejin being accosted by suited thugs. Like a fairtytale, he suddenly has a new lease on life. After rescuing her, Soohan promises to protect her, happy to take only her watch as collateral. Meanwhile, Soohan's boss starts looking for Yejin and soon learns of their relationship.

programme.title: Orang Minyak : 3 Cerita 3 Sutradara
programme.desc: Ikuti 3 kisah orang minyak yang diarahkan oleh 3 sutradara.

programme.title: The Free Fall
programme.desc: Sara discovers her mom stabbing her dad with a knife before slicing her own throat. After a failed suicide attempt, the traumatized young woman awakes from a coma with total memory loss, only to be greeted by her husband, Nick, whom she has no recollection of. She tries to piece together the events that led to her attempted suicide and to get accustomed to her new life, but reality grows murkier everyday until she is unsure what is real and what is not.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: Ron is a travelling salesman who is superstitious. Each time he stays in a new hotel room, he would perform all steps needed to avoid offending any spirits, such as knocking the door and politely greeting the room before entering it. He would also cover any mirror that faces the bed. Yet, when he returns from a late-night dinner, the room still feels eerily strange.

programme.title: Malaysian Ghost Stories
programme.desc: Nusantara is a place full of mystical spirits and the supernatural. Each episode has a unique solution depending on the type of disturbance, the type of genie and the effect on the main character.

programme.title: Dukun
programme.desc: Lawyer, Karim, is searching for his missing child, Nadia. His desperation leads him to be entangled with an alleged murderer, Diana Dahlan. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

programme.title: The Spirit of Ramayana
programme.desc: In order to prove herself to her family, 24-year-old contemporary dancer Mintra auditions for a new play called "Ramayana", hoping to land her dream role Seeda. But the director deems her too nice for the role, which portrays contrasting sides of good and evil. Instead, her rival Gina is chosen for the role, awakening resentment in Mintra and prompting her to accept the offer of a female ghost to help bring out her dark side.

programme.title: The Jack In The Box Rises
programme.desc: When Raven is sent to an all-girls boarding school, she unwittingly unleashes a demon from a mysterious vintage Jack-in-the-box hidden on the school grounds. Now, she and the other students must fight for survival against the unleashed demon.

programme.title: Kerat 14
programme.desc: Haziq dan Nuzara merupakan pasangan kekasih dan Haziq amat menyayangi Nurzara, namun Haziq terlibat dengan aktiviti sosial dan tidak disenangi oleh Nuzara. Dalam masa yang sama Aril muncul dan mula tertarik dengan kecantikan Nuzara ketika Nuzara dan Haziq berada di salah sebuah kelab di Kuala Lumpur. Sebuah tragedi ngeri yang tidak disengajakan telah berlaku dalam kisah cinta Haziq dan Nuzara dan penyiasatan dilakukan oleh ASP Razman.

programme.title: Phone
programme.desc: Soon after getting a new phone, an investigative reporter named Ji-won begin receiving a series of disturbing calls. To escape the terrifying and relentless ringing of the phone, she changes her number and moves out to her sister's home. But the threatening campaign of terror continues, even as Ji-Won unravels the mystery behind the phone.

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.

programme.title: Kawan Aku Mati Dalam Rumah Sewa

The three of them rent a house from Pak Cik Osman but they are three months behind in rent. One day, Pak Cik Osman's nephew Saipol, an illegal motor racer, comes to put with them for a while. That night, Saipol wins a race and goes home with RM10,000 in cash on him. Rudy so happens to get home at the same time, still in his vampire costume. Saipol is so frightened that he has a heart attack and dies on the spot. Akhiruddin and Remy follow behind and the three bachelors start panicking over what to do with Saipol's corpse. Will Saipol come back to haunt them and get back the money?
